role: Free functions for sharing the recap card: write a named PNG to tmp, find the topmost presenter, present a UIActivityViewController with an iPad popover anchor.
toplevel: Global free functions only; callers DashboardV2View+Chips.swift:391-392, RecoveryScoreDetailView+Panels.swift:378-379, PDFPreviewView.Coordinator.shareAction.

units.does: Writes the image PNG to tmp/emuqu-<yyyy-MM-dd>-score-<score>.png (POSIX Gregorian date) and returns that URL; if pngData is nil or the write throws (logged by attempt), returns the UIImage itself.

branches.effect: return file URL; else return raw image (generic attachment name)

flags.text: The PNG containing the user's recovery score (also in the filename) is written to the temporary directory and never deleted after sharing; it persists until iOS purges tmp.

units.does: Finds the foreground-active UIWindowScene, takes the key window's root (or first window's), and walks presentedViewController while not being dismissed; returns nil when no active scene/root.

branches.cond: foreground-active UIWindowScene found and a root VC exists

branches.effect: use it; else ?? first window's root

branches.cond: presented VC exists and is not being dismissed
branches.effect: descend; else stop and return current

units.does: Creates a UIActivityViewController for one item, anchors its popover to the presenter's view centre (no arrow) when one exists (iPad), and presents it.

branches.effect: set source view/rect, no arrows; iPhone skips
